page_title: PAR 1-3 ATA | Parma v Atalanta 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Gianluca Manganiello is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' The foul by Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Gianluca Manganiello.
90+3' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+2' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Parma earn a corner.
90+1' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) has received a yellow card for his foul.
87' Referee Gianluca Manganiello sees the trip by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
86' The shots on goal statistics – 3:6.
82' Fabio Pecchia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) replacing Matteo Cancellieri.
82' The manager makes a subsitution with Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) coming on for Ademola Lookman.
82' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Rafael Toloi and he is replaced by Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta).
75' 1 - 3 Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb inside the left post. What a beautiful shot.
72' A goal, which was scored by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta), was disallowed due to offside.
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nahuel Estevez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
71' That's the end of the game for Ange-Yoan Bonny, who is replaced by Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma).
71' The game has come to an end for Woyo Coulibaly. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Antoine Hainaut (Parma).
70' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Raoul Bellanova will be replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta).
67' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
66' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) picks up an injury.
66' The corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is hurriedly cleared.
65' An attempted cross from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Atalanta will have a corner.
65' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
64' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
61' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
58' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for an infringement.
55' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) replaces Mateo Retegui.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch for Mario Pasalic.
54' Confusion on the bench but it seems Gian Piero Gasperini has received a second yellow card from the ref and is walking off!
53' Gian Piero Gasperini is stunned as referee Gianluca Manganiello shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
53' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is adjudged offside.
53' Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight and sees a foul from Enrico Del Prato (Parma).

49' 1 - 2 Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Marco Carnesecchi is just a bystander as the ball flies under the crossbar. The score is 1:2.
47' The ball is cleared after Valentin Mihaila (Parma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Adrian Benedyczak comes off for Valentin Mihaila (Parma).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Dennis Man (Parma) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

45' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Marco Carnesecchi blocks the shot with his legs. The ball goes out of play. Parma are awarded a corner kick.
44' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) tackles a bit over-zealously and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
44' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
43' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
39' 0 - 2 Goal! Matteo Ruggeri passes the ball to the feet of Ederson (Atalanta), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:2.
36' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
34' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post.
33' Ederson (Atalanta) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
30' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is caught offside!
30' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
30' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Now Atalanta have a corner.
28' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
24' Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul after Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
19' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Mateo Retegui (Atalanta), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
17' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Mateo Retegui (Atalanta), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
16' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).
12' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).
10' The goal by Atalanta is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
10' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Atalanta players aren’t happy.
9' Mario Pasalic provides Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
4' 0 - 1 Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) latches onto a brilliant cross and produces a perfect header that goes inside the left post to give the goalkeeper no chance!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello is introduced as the referee for today's match.
